prompt.task: Log in to Default Browser and go to airbnb.com/login with username {user} and password {password}. You are authorized to perform 2FA if required.
prompt.system_addendum: You are authorized to operate the device for this task. The device PIN is {device_pin}.

auto_verifier.reason: The run starts on the Android launcher, continuously opens signed-out Chrome, enters the supplied Airbnb email, encounters the email-OTP challenge, uses Airbnb's offered password alternative, submits the supplied password, and ends on the authenticated airbnb.com/users/profile page for {account_name} (Guest).
